description_en: Retrieves the details of the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account and the details of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to which the assets belong. The assets can be elastic IP addresses (EIPs). The assets can also be Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances that are assigned public IP addresses
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号拥有的公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例）的DDoS防护信息以及所属原生防护实例的详情
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-instance-ip-address --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceIpAddress

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

ecs: ECS instances.

slb: SLB instances.

eip: EIPs.

ipv6: IPv6 gateways.

swas: simple application servers.

waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF) instances of the Exclusive edition.

ga_basic: Global Accelerator (GA) instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示查询云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示查询负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示查询弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示查询IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示查询轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示查询Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示查询全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the asset. Valid values:

defense: queries assets for which traffic scrubbing is performed.

blackhole: queries assets for which blackhole filtering is triggered
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态。取值：

defense：表示清洗中，即查询正在进行流量清洗的公网IP资产。
blackhole：表示黑洞中，即查询处于黑洞状态的公网IP资产
parameters.name: ddos_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the asset is added
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所属的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址
parameters.name: instance_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的公网IP资产信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条公网IP资产信息
parameters.name: page_size

InstanceList.description_en: An array that consists of details of the instance
InstanceList.description_zh: 公网IP资产所属实例的详情列表

items.description_zh: 公网IP资产所属实例的详情列表

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the instance. Valid values:

normal: not under DDoS attacks.

abnormal: under DDoS attacks
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例的DDoS防护状态。取值：

normal：表示正常。
abnormal：表示被攻击中

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

ecs

slb

eip

IpAddressConfig.description_en: An array that consists of the details of the asset

BlackholeThreshold.description_en: The basic protection threshold for the asset. Unit: Mbit/s
BlackholeThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的DDoS基础防护阈值。单位：Mbps

DefenseBpsThreshold.description_en: The traffic scrubbing threshold for the asset measured in Mbit/s. Unit: Mbit/s
DefenseBpsThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的流量清洗阈值。单位：Mbps

DefensePpsThreshold.description_en: The traffic scrubbing threshold for the asset measured in packets per second (PPS). Unit: PPS
DefensePpsThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的报文数量清洗阈值。单位：pps

ElasticThreshold.description_en: The burstable protection threshold for the asset. Unit: Mbit/s
ElasticThreshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的DDoS弹性防护阈值。单位：Mbps

InstanceIp.description_en: The IP address of the asset

IpStatus.description_en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the asset. Valid values:

mitigating: indicates that traffic scrubbing is in progress.

blackholed: indicates that blackhole filtering is triggered for the asset.

normal: indicates that no DDoS attacks are launched against the asset
IpStatus.description_zh:
公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态。取值：

mitigating：表示清洗中。
blackholed：表示黑洞中。
normal：表示正常

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP version of the IP address. Valid values:

v4: IPv4.

v6: IPv6
IpVersion.description_zh:
IP地址的协议类型。取值：

v4：表示IPv4协议。
v6：表示IPv6协议

IsBgppack.description_en:
Indicates whether the asset is added to the instance. Valid values:

true

false
IsBgppack.description_zh:
公网IP资产是否已绑定DDoS原生防护。取值：

true：表示是。
false：表示否

IsFullProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether best-effort protection is enabled for the asset. Valid values:

0: no.

1: yes
IsFullProtection.description_zh:
公网IP资产是否在原生防护中全力防护。取值：

0：表示非全力防护。
1：表示全力防护

RegionId.description_en: The region code of the asset
RegionId.description_zh: 公网IP资产所属的地域编码

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Total.description_en: The total number of the assets
Total.description_zh: 查询到的公网IP资产的总数量
